verdict.rationale: Capacities is a note-taking/knowledge management app with automated exports, templates, and AI auto-fill, but there is no evidence of a user-defined rules/trigger-action automation system (e.g., 'when X happens, do Y') for arbitrary events. Scheduled export is the closest automation but it is a single fixed feature, not a general rule/event-trigger system. Missing for 10: any documented trigger-action rule builder, event-based automation, or workflow engine tied to arbitrary events.
